page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornament (a female head between two feather and fruit cornucopias, with scrolls) at the centre, with the printed initials "T. V." beneath it. Below, handwriting and ink smudges, which are not printed and are left out.
page.notes: Engraving: a decorative ornament with a female head in a helmet of feathers, flanked by fruit and foliage cornucopias and scrolls, with a shell at its base. Beneath the engraving: handwritten name (partly legible as "L. Wilhelmi" with a flourish) and a flourished ink scribble, a smudged pencil or ink sketch. These are manuscript, not print, and are not transcribed. No page number, running head or catchword.
